name: memoforge
description: Multi-agent legal memo drafting: intake questions, planned legal research, a frozen source pack with verifiable quotes, a counterargument and citation review loop, and a footnoted docx deliverable.

output_folder.title: Output folder
output_folder.description: Where task folders are created. Default: ~/Documents/memoforge, then ./outputs/memoforge-work.

publish_folder.title: Publish folder
publish_folder.description: Where the finished result is copied: deliverable, summary and the frozen source texts. Default: the host's outputs area when one exists (Cowork `/mnt/user-data/outputs`), else nothing is copied.

writer_model.title: Writer model
writer_model.description: Model for memo-writer: opus, fable or sonnet. An unknown value falls back to opus.

source_review_gate.title: Source-pack review gate
source_review_gate.description: Show the source-pack review gate: auto (mode decides), on (always) or off (never).

citation_style.title: Citation style
citation_style.description: How citations appear in the memorandum: inline (short parenthetical citations linked to the source, full records in the Sources annex) or footnotes (a Word footnote per citation).

dashboard.title: Live dashboard
dashboard.description: Publish a live Artifact dashboard for the run (one extra tool call per step). Turn off to save calls; if the host has no Artifact tool the run continues without it.

stop_guard.title: Stop guard
stop_guard.description: Block the end of a turn while a task is mid-phase, at most twice per phase.

websearch_autoallow.title: Auto-allow WebSearch
websearch_autoallow.description: Auto-approve WebSearch while a memoforge task is active.
